question: When you buy into BlackRock's BUIDL fund, send USDC or buy a tokenized share, which company is responsible at each step?
answer: A different company at almost every step, and the money step is mostly unmapped. In a BUIDL subscription, Securitize Markets, LLC gives eligible investors access, the fund (BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.) issues the shares, Securitize, LLC keeps the share register, and The Bank of New York Mellon must confirm the subscription money first. For USDC, Circle Internet Financial, LLC is the issuer behind each documented step, but a token transfer alone is not a bank payout. For the Coinbase tokenized share, Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd issues the certificate, Alpaca Securities LLC holds the underlying Apple share, Base carries the token and Onchain Marketplace Limited keeps the Legal Register that decides ownership. Across the three, 10 of 12 money steps are not mapped in the library's evidence.

sections.title: Step by step
sections.sub: Each card names who does the job in each lane, what the evidence says and where it stops.

groups.label: BUIDL · subscribe and record fund shares
groups.note: Follow the fund share, subscription money and official register. This maps contractual responsibilities; individual payment receipts remain unresolved.

items.title: Eligible offering access
items.sub: BUIDL · subscribe and record fund shares · step 1 of 4
kv: The asset
Securitize Markets, LLC. BUIDL is offered through the named placement and access function for eligible investors.
The money
No company named. The payment instruction, bank, funding account, and receipt for a particular subscription are not mapped.
The official record
Securitize Markets, LLC; Securitize, LLC; BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.. Eligibility to enter an offering is documented separately from the shareholder record.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Product-specific eligibility and offering restrictions remain controlling; placement authority is not transfer-agent authority.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. The saved BUIDL records do not establish a subscription-payment route or completed cash posting.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Admission does not by itself establish a recorded fund-share entitlement.

sources.label: BUIDL platform, transfer agent and registrar agreement

items.title: Fund-share issuance and control book
items.sub: BUIDL · subscribe and record fund shares · step 2 of 4
kv: The asset
BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.; Securitize, LLC. The fund issuer creates shares; Securitize acts under its appointment.
The money
The Bank of New York Mellon; Securitize, LLC. Issuance requires confirmation of receipt or credit of subscription funds to the custodian.
The official record
Securitize, LLC; BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.. Securitize maintains the issuer’s share register.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Manager, fund, and transfer agent are separate persons and systems.
The money: status and limit
Documented. Contractual condition in section 2.3; a particular investor’s payment receipt is not provided.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. The control book is distinct from a wallet, bridge, or chain consensus record.

sources.label: BUIDL platform, transfer agent and registrar agreement

items.title: Named network representation
items.sub: BUIDL · subscribe and record fund shares · step 3 of 4
kv: The asset
Ethereum / ETH. BUIDL has named live representations on supported networks, including Ethereum.
The money
No company named. No network representation establishes a subscription payment or cash settlement path.
The official record

Securitize Corp.; Securitize, LLC; Wormhole protocol; BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.. Securitize's multichain model uses Wormhole infrastructure while the regulated control book remains external to transport.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Network availability is not proof that a network is the exclusive or legally authoritative register.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. The saved evidence does not link the representation to a particular money movement.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Transport does not replace the transfer-agent record or determine legal title.

BUIDL platform, transfer agent and registrar agreement

items.title: Servicing and correction
items.sub: BUIDL · subscribe and record fund shares · step 4 of 4
kv: The asset
Securitize, LLC; BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.. Ongoing BUIDL share servicing remains governed by the reviewed transfer-agent agreement.
The money
No company named. Cash redemption route and payout completion for this case are not documented here.
The official record
Securitize, LLC; BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund Ltd.. Securitize may refuse a transfer lacking valid authority.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. The terms and required instructions determine whether a transfer is recognized.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. The case does not treat a separate RLUSD exchange option as a subscription or fiat-payout proof.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Contract sections 3.2–3.5 address transfer instructions and adverse claims; network consensus is not that authorization.

sources.label: BUIDL platform, transfer agent and registrar agreement

groups.label: USDC · issue, transfer and redeem
groups.note: Follow the token, reserve money and issuer records. Direct redemption depends on customer eligibility; token movement does not prove bank payout.

items.title: Mint access and eligibility
items.sub: USDC · issue, transfer and redeem · step 1 of 4
kv: The asset
No company named. Circle Mint provides the access path for an eligible institution to seek issuance of USDC.
The money
No company named. A specific incoming USD payment route or settlement receipt is not mapped.
The official record
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. The applicable legal issuer is the issuer-side liability and instruction authority for USDC.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. KYC and service access are mapped; a particular bank-funding instruction and posting receipt are absent.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. Access eligibility does not prove bank funding, reserve receipt, or final settlement of a given order.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. The issuer perimeter remains distinct from Circle Mint access and from every supported network.

items.title: Reserve and native mint
items.sub: USDC · issue, transfer and redeem · step 2 of 4
kv: The asset
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. Native USDC is minted under issuer instruction on a selected supported chain.
The money
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. Dollar assets enter an issuer-specific segregated reserve pool.
The official record
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. The issuer's USDC obligation and reserve records remain separate from token state.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. This generic trace does not specify the selected-chain execution for a particular issuance.
The money: status and limit
Documented. The reserve-pool role is mapped, not a transaction-level reserve inflow posting.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Chain state does not itself establish the issuer liability or reserve position.

sources.label: Circle Mint supported chains and currencies

items.title: Token transport
items.sub: USDC · issue, transfer and redeem · step 3 of 4
kv: The asset
No company named. USDC can move through wallets and supported transport mechanisms.
The money
No company named. No token transfer alone establishes an FX conversion, bank payout, or new fiat settlement.
The official record
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. Technical token state and transport are distinct from the issuer liability record and redemption eligibility.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. The mechanisms are alternatives, not successive mandatory hops in one transaction.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. Token transport is not evidence of completed money movement outside the issuer claim.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Chain finality does not guarantee direct Circle redemption eligibility.

sources.label: Circle Mint supported chains and currencies

items.title: Redemption and bank payout
items.sub: USDC · issue, transfer and redeem · step 4 of 4
kv: The asset
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. USDC is burned under applicable issuer eligibility rules when redeemed.
The money
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. Reserve liquidity is intended to become bank USD payout, but a separate direct-Circle payout completion card is not mapped.
The official record
Circle Internet Financial, LLC. Issuer redemption terms govern the obligation; token burn and bank payout remain distinct evidence points.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. No transaction-specific burn receipt is supplied.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. Do not use a distinct Tazapay conversion/local-payout route to fill this direct-redemption gap.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Burn does not by itself prove completed bank payout or discharge for a specific customer.

groups.label: Coinbase certificate · underlying share to registered title
groups.note: Follow the underlying share, issued certificate and controlling register. Wallet possession and registered ownership are distinct.

items.title: Creation admission
items.sub: Coinbase certificate · underlying share to registered title · step 1 of 4
kv: The asset
Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd. An Authorized Participant submits the current in-kind creation order for the certificate process.
The money
No company named. This is an in-kind underlying-security creation case; no cash payment route is mapped.
The official record
Onchain Marketplace Limited. Certificate eligibility and later vesting gates are distinct from wallet possession.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Eligibility is mapped, but acceptance of a particular in-kind creation instruction lacks a dedicated card.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. The saved trace does not establish a cash-leg settlement for an individual creation.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Admission does not itself establish registered ownership.

items.title: Underlying custody and certificate issuance
items.sub: Coinbase certificate · underlying share to registered title · step 2 of 4
kv: The asset
Alpaca Securities LLC; Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd. AAPL enters the issuer-named Alpaca custody account; Coinbase Onchain SPV holds deposited property on trust and legally issues the certificate.
The money
No company named. No cash purchase, securities-loan, or cash-settlement instruction is documented for this stage.
The official record
Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd. The SPV-issued certificate is a distinct legal object against deposited underlying property.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. The certificate is not direct ownership of the underlying U.S. share, and the underlying company does not sponsor it.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. Custody and certificate issuance do not prove a separate cash leg.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Underlying custody is separate from certificate issuance, wallet possession, and Base state.

items.title: Base representation and vesting
items.sub: Coinbase certificate · underlying share to registered title · step 3 of 4
kv: The asset
Base. The B20 certificate is represented on Base.
The money
Base. Base transaction ordering and Ethereum settlement do not identify a cash settlement.
The official record
Base; Onchain Marketplace Limited. Wallet control creates an onchain position, while OML separately applies eligibility and vesting checks.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Legal issuance and Base representation are mapped; the OML-specific mint action is not separately recorded.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. Sequencer ordering and Ethereum finality do not determine certificate cash settlement.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. Wallet possession alone does not establish registered title.

items.title: Legal Register finality and servicing
items.sub: Coinbase certificate · underlying share to registered title · step 4 of 4
kv: The asset
Onchain Marketplace Limited. Certificate rights, including redemption and voting eligibility, depend on registered and vested status.
The money
No company named. A cash redemption or payout route is not established by the certificate or its Base representation.
The official record
Onchain Marketplace Limited. OML operates the definitive Legal Register; registered entry and vesting determine certificate title.
The asset: status and limit
Documented. Unvested holders lack the documented redemption and voting rights.
The money: status and limit
Not mapped. The trace does not supply a dedicated redemption/burn execution or cash-settlement action.
The official record: status and limit
Documented. The Legal Register, rather than Base state or wallet possession alone, controls title and servicing.

catalog_context.title: Who actually controls the crypto infrastructure
catalog_context.answer: Of 20 crypto networks and companies we track, only one is used at scale and none is proven under stress; many brands rest on a handful of legal providers.

catalog_context.title: Which companies actually run the new digital-money system?
catalog_context.answer: No single coin is winning. The field is becoming many specialized networks linked through a few companies and regulated middlemen, and the native tokens are mostly fuel, not the money institutions actually move.
